This section (labelled Section 1.) is part of EO 13326, the order that established the President's Commission on Implementation of United States Space Exploration Policy. Section 3 of EO 13385 of September 29, 2005 (70 FR 57989, published October 4, 2005)  revokes the order by number and lists it among orders that established committees which the revoking order describes as terminated or with completed work; the revoking text reads "(b) Executive Order 13326, establishing the President ’s Commission on 
Implementation of United States Space Exploration Policy." Section 10 of EO 13385 states "This order shall be effective September 30, 2005.", so the revocation took effect on that date. The clause therefore ended on 2005-09-30.

savings.reason: Section 3 of EO 13385 of September 29, 2005 (70 FR 57989, published October 4, 2005) revokes EO 13326 by number and contains no saving provision for it. The order created an advisory commission and directed support and reports for it; no continuing independent command or accrued obligation is shown in the held texts.
